name: Midnight Date Unleashed
detailed_description:
Midnight Date Unleashed is a Racing Dating Sim that reimagines the thrill of the road. In this game, it's not about crossing the finish line first—it's about driving with style to impress your beautiful passenger. Perform breathtaking maneuvers, drift through neon-lit streets, and take control of the night as you build the perfect Heart Score to win her affection.

🔥 Key Features 🔥

🚗 Drive to Impress
Master the art of smooth drifting, precise acceleration, and bold maneuvers to make your date's heart race—both figuratively and literally! But beware—reckless driving and crashing will ruin the mood. Find the perfect balance of thrill and control to create an unforgettable ride.

💖 Real-Time Character Reactions
Your passenger will respond dynamically to your driving skills. Show off the right moves, and you’ll see her excitement grow through facial expressions and body language. However, push things too far, and she might get nervous or even frustrated! There are four levels of excitement, so pay close attention to her reactions.

🌆 Explore Thai-Inspired Roads
Race through beautifully designed environments based on real locations in Thailand, including:
🏙️ Bangkok’s Neon Streets – A dazzling cityscape full of vibrant nightlife.
🌊 Pattaya Beachside Drive – A romantic coastal route with stunning ocean views.

📸 Unlock Exclusive Date Memories
The better you drive, the more special moments you unlock! Reach the highest Heart Score to collect unique date photos, proving you’ve mastered the art of romantic driving.

🎶 Electrifying Soundtrack
Set the mood for your midnight ride with a pulse-pounding soundtrack featuring a fusion of Hyper Pop, Hard style, and City Pop. Whether you're gliding through neon streets or pushing the limits on a winding mountain road, the music will keep your adrenaline high and your heart racing.

🏁 Are You Ready for the Ultimate Midnight Date?
Take the wheel and experience a thrilling mix of high-speed romance, stylish driving, and unforgettable nights. In Midnight Date Unleashed, every turn is a chance to impress, and every ride is a date to remember!

Choose your girls, and don’t forget to pick your perfect ride!

You can drift to impress!

Enjoy seeing the girls' reactions in real time!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K 3.3GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 550 Ti or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 3.2 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960 or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
